# Finance import fixtures

These files are synthetic. IBANs, merchants, names and amounts are invented. No file claims to match
the layout of a real bank (the app ships generic CSV profiles only).

They are generated by `Tests\Support\CsvFixtures::statement()` with the options listed in
`CsvFixtures::committed()`. `tests/Unit/Finance/Import/DecoderTest.php` regenerates them and compares byte
for byte, so an encoding regression is visible in review. To regenerate after an intentional change:

```php
foreach (Tests\Support\CsvFixtures::committed() as $name => $opts) {
    file_put_contents("tests/fixtures/finance/$name", Tests\Support\CsvFixtures::statement($opts));
}
```

- `statement-sk-windows1250.csv`: Windows-1250, `;`, CRLF, preamble and footer, identical same-day rows.
- `statement-pl-iso88592.csv`: ISO-8859-2, `;`, LF, ISO dates, dot decimals, one quoted multi-line row.
- `statement-utf8-bom.csv`: UTF-8 with BOM, `,`, split debit/credit, dates with a time suffix.
